focus: City of Atlanta (Downtown, Midtown, Home Park, Morningside, Inman Park, Edgewood, Glenwood Park, Summerhill, East Atlanta, West Midtown, Riverside, Buckhead, Chastain, and Southwest Atlanta)
intro: This first Atlanta page covers private mailbox stores inside the city whose own public pages list an address, staffed hours, and package acceptance — four independent pack-and-ship stores (Downtown, Inman Park, East Atlanta, and Southwest Atlanta) plus sixteen UPS Store locations from Downtown and Midtown up to Buckhead and Chastain, most of them open on Sundays. It is not a complete metro inventory; Sandy Springs, Decatur, Dunwoody, Marietta, and other suburbs are not covered yet. 24-hour lobby access is flagged only when the store’s own page says so. The UPS Store pages mention 24-hour access only at participating locations, so that flag is off for those stores. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.name: Qwik Pack & Ship
listings.address: 2373 Fairburn Rd SW, Atlanta, GA 30331

hours.notes: Staffed store hours as shown on the mailbox rental page for November 21–27, 2026. The same page says mailbox customers have 24-hour access to a brightly lit, secure mailbox area.

listings.carriersNotes: The mailbox rental page says the store accepts packages and mail from the Post Office, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and couriers.
listings.visitNotes: The mailbox rental page says mailbox customers have 24-hour access to a brightly lit, secure mailbox area. It does not say whether packages too large for a box can be picked up after staffed hours. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
